note: Facts plus a look. Radii are the NSSDC fact sheet's printed edges (km, about Saturn's centre, in its equator plane). Colours and opacities are Planetary Explorer's Saturn ring bands (donor src/entities/saturn.ts), one per ring: where the donor splits a ring into steps (C ring 0.20-0.24, B ring 0.78-0.90, A ring 0.55-0.68) the middle value is used. The fact sheet lists the Titan ringlet, the Maxwell, Encke and Keeler gaps and the F ring as single radii with no width, so they are not drawn (the donor's thin gaps and F ring are left out); the Cassini Division is drawn as the donor's dark translucent band. The diffuse E ring (180,000-480,000 km) is not drawn: it would shrink the main rings to a few pixels in the one 2048-pixel ring texture. The G ring has no donor band; its look is Astraeus's (faint dust). Brightness is a look, not a measurement.
